producer_preserving_locator.law: locator_id and storage_locator are administrative/nonsemantic; complete authoritative producer tuple must be exactly reversible without text/fuzzy rematching

encoding_rules: object keys in deterministic ascending Unicode scalar-value order
strings preserve exact Unicode scalar sequence with no normalization/trimming/case-folding/semantic rewriting
administrative integers use canonical base-10 representation
semantic arrays preserve producer-declared semantic order
unordered arrays may sort for deterministic bytes only when governing authority says order_significant=false
self-hash fields and volatile transport metadata are excluded from the object they hash
publication_content_hash_binds: transitive-closure manifest hash and every root closure digest
publication_identity_hash_binds: publication bundle/manifest schema IDs and versions
repository_content_hash_binds: source V557 publication bundle ID/identity/content/manifest hashes

repository_identity_hash_binds: source V557 publication bundle ID/identity/content hashes
canonical_hash_policy.mutation_law: Any content/identity-bound change creates a new content/identity hash and new bundle ID; existing publication/repository bundles never mutate in place.

required_exact_preservation: producer permission ceiling and exact CAN-003 item-use decision
proof_obligations: every V558 locator reverses exactly to one producer tuple without fuzzy/text rematching
V558 reference graph represents references only and is never a replacement domain-edge ontology
indexes are lossless/reversible views over immutable producer-preserving locators
hash equality alone never authorizes semantic coalescing across distinct producer identities
with raw producer directories absent, every admitted root and required transitive dependency resolves from packaged material or exact packaged content-addressed locators

transitive_closure.follow_rule: Recursively follow only schema/reference-contract-declared interpretation-critical semantic references; arbitrary prose/audit mentions are not closure edges unless producer authority declares them semantic.
leaf_satisfaction: target object/material is included and content-addressed
governed authority/rule/predicate/version is included or exactly immutable-addressable under a packaged hash-bound contract
explicit external immutable authority locator is packaged with exact identity/version/hash and a non-fuzzy non-latest resolution contract
transitive_closure.strong_reference_law: Where producer/reference-contract law requires one exact target, zero matches or multiple incompatible matches is integrity failure unless producer law explicitly authorizes multiplicity/noncomparability.
transitive_closure.edge_role_vocabulary_law: Role names are packaging labels only when exact producer/reference-contract authority supplies the role; CAN-004 does not create absent roles.
cardinality_law: producer-declared cardinality is transported, never re-derived as new semantic authority
when producer/reference-contract law binds participant cardinality, declared_cardinality equals exact role-qualified participant-ref count
genuinely n-ary producer objects remain n-ary; no dyadization, collapse, duplication, synthesis or winner selection
order_law: producer-declared semantic order is preserved by exact role/ordinal semantics
serialization order is never semantic order
unordered/symmetric sets may sort only for deterministic bytes when order_significant=false
changing an order-significant ordinal/role changes closure digest and publication/repository identity
transitive_closure.closure_digest_law: Each root digest binds canonical producer-preserving nodes/hashes plus typed edges including reference-contract identity, role, requiredness, participant role, cardinality/multiplicity, order-significance and semantic ordinal; aggregate digest binds all root digests under deterministic root ordering.

item_denial_law.dependency_permission_noninheritance: active root never widens dependency state
item_denial_law.collection_state_nonauthority: READY/VALID_NONEMPTY cannot substitute for per-item authorization

semantic_state_separation.physical_missing_dependency_law: A required transitive reference that should resolve but is absent/corrupt is INTEGRITY_FAILURE, not producer MISSING_AUTHORITY.

rules: exact producer/schema/rule/predicate/reference-contract IDs, versions and hashes govern
unknown future versions are not grandfathered by family/name similarity
mutable latest/current/default is discovery metadata only
compatibility alias must already be governed exact one-to-one lossless and hash-bound
CAN-004 does not author semantic adapters
compatibility cannot convert global to item permission, scalar/readiness to use, missing to deny, noncomparable to negative, valid-empty to failure, merge temporal proxies or widen permission
same bytes under different producer identities/versions do not establish semantic equivalence
any accepted compatibility/policy binding change creates a new immutable publication/repository identity
